# OCR_ACCURACY_REPORT.md: native document extraction, measured (Phase 40)

Measured 2026-10-05 on instance `pwcmanagementservicesdemo01` (Yokohama).

**Scope of the numbers: 23 SYNTHETIC documents generated by the project. No Birla Carbon document has been received or measured.** Nothing below is an accuracy figure for client documents. Accuracy on real client invoices and payment advices is **NOT MEASURED** until samples are supplied (`CLIENT_POC_TEST_MATRIX.md` §1).

## 1. What was measured

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | ServiceNow Document Intelligence v8.0.2, generative pipeline, skill "Document Key Value Extraction (NowLLM)" |
| Model | `gpt_oss_120b` through the ServiceNow-hosted Now LLM Service (pinned per use case with `provider.use_now_llm`; the instance-default Azure OpenAI definition is not used by BCFA) |
| Use cases | BCFA AP Invoice Extraction (Now LLM), 25 fields; BCFA AR Payment Advice Extraction (Now LLM), 12 fields (`scripts/deploy/native_extraction_config.json`) |
| Documents | Set 1: 14 fixtures of Phases 31-35 (6 AP invoices, 8 AR remittances). Set 2: 9 Phase 40 fixtures (5 AP invoices, 4 AR advices). Every page carries a SYNTHETIC watermark |
| Ground truth | `scripts/eval/ground_truth_synthetic.json`, `ground_truth_synthetic_set2.json`: only fields printed on each document |
| Scorer | `scripts/eval/score_extraction.py` (field level: exact, normalized, missed, incorrect, false positive; header, line and critical groups) |
| Raw outputs | `scripts/eval/results/native_synthetic*_2026-10-05.json`, copied verbatim from `di_genai_output.data` |

Critical fields, AP: vendor name, invoice number, PO number, currency, gross amount, tax amount. AR: payer, payment reference, payment amount, currency, invoice references. A document is *straight-through extraction* when every critical field is correct and no critical field is a false positive. Whether it then flows without review is decided by the deterministic pipeline (derived confidence, completeness, matching), not by this score.

## 2. Results

Run 1: original field descriptions. Run 2: descriptions of *VAT Amount*, *Withholding Tax Amount* and *Withholding Tax Rate Percent* made explicit about printed labels (MwSt. / USt. / ÁFA, "Less: TDS @ 2%"); nothing else changed.

| Run | Set | Header correct | Line fields correct | Critical correct | Straight-through docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Set 1 (14) | 121 / 123 (98.4 %) | 54 / 54 | 74 / 75 | 13 / 14 |
| 1 | Set 2 (9) | 110 / 113 (97.3 %) | 292 / 292 | 50 / 50 | 9 / 9 |
| **1** | **All 23** | **231 / 236 (97.9 %)** | **346 / 346** | **124 / 125 (99.2 %)** | **22 / 23** |
| 2 | Set 1 (14) | 121 / 123 (98.4 %) | 54 / 54 | 73 / 75 | 12 / 14 |
| 2 | Set 2 (9) | 110 / 113 (97.3 %) | 292 / 292 | 50 / 50 | 9 / 9 |
| **2** | **All 23** | **231 / 236 (97.9 %)** | **346 / 346** | **123 / 125 (98.4 %)** | **21 / 23** |

Per-document detail: `scripts/eval/results/*_score.md`.

## 3. Every difference found

| Document | Field | Run 1 | Run 2 | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AP_INV_103_VAT7_DE (German, MwSt. 7 %) | vat_amount | missed | missed | Tuning did not help. The total tax (144.12) and rate (7) were read correctly; validation uses the total tax |
| AP_INV_104_WHT_SERVICES (TDS printed) | wht_amount | missed | missed | Tuning did not help |
| AP_INV_104_WHT_SERVICES | wht_rate_pct | missed | **correct (2)** | Fixed by the tuned description |
| AP_INV_003_PRICE_VARIANCE | document_language | missed | correct | Field unchanged: run-to-run variation |
| AP_INV_006_LOW_CONFIDENCE (degraded by design) | vendor_name (critical) | correct | **missed** | Field unchanged: run-to-run variation. The provider lowers the derived confidence, so the invoice goes to review |
| AR_REMIT_201_TDS | deduction_reason (header) | correct | missed | Field unchanged. The per-invoice reasons ("TDS @2%") were read in both runs |
| AR_REMIT_005_ALIAS_CUSTOMER | customer_name (critical) | wrong | wrong | Printed remitter "LONE STAR TYRE CO"; the model returned the legal name "Lone Star Tyre Corp" from elsewhere on the page. The alias check in customer resolution is where this is caught |
| AP_INV_006_LOW_CONFIDENCE | freight_amount | false positive | false positive | The single freight line was also returned as a freight charge |
| AR_REMIT_003_SHORT_PAY | deduction amount / reason | false positive | false positive | Derived from the "partial payment" wording, not printed as a deduction |
| AR_REMIT_204_MULTI_DEDUCTION | deduction_reason (header) | false positive | false positive | A remark line was returned as the header reason; the three per-invoice reasons were correct |

Line items: all 346 expected line values were correct in both runs, including the 44-line, 2-page Hungarian invoice.

## 4. What this does and does not show

- Generative native extraction reads clean, machine-generated synthetic PDFs reliably for headers and lines, in English and German, in INR / EUR / USD, with Indian, German and English number formats.
- **The model is not deterministic.** Two runs on the same documents differed in 4 fields that were not changed. A production design must not depend on one read being right: the derived confidence, the mandatory-field check, arithmetic checks (net + tax = total, line sum = net) and human review on failure stay essential.
- Prompt (description) tuning had a limited effect: 1 of 3 targeted misses was fixed.
- **Not tested at all:** scanned or photographed documents, handwriting, low-resolution images, rotated pages, non-Latin scripts, real supplier layouts, documents over 2 pages, password-protected PDFs.

## 5. Platform limitations found (not BCFA defects)

| Limitation | Effect on BCFA | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| The generative pipeline returns **no per-field confidence** | No platform confidence to show per field | `NativeDocumentIntelligenceProvider._confidence` derives one (−0.2 per missing critical field, arithmetic checks) and labels it "Derived" |
| The bounding-box mapping (`candidate_id`) came back **empty** in every run | No page / position evidence per field | Evidence is the field value text per field only. The position-evidence criterion is **NOT MET** in the POC |
| Ambiguous numbers ("1.234") | Read as 1234 (grouping) | Locale-aware parser `_num`; ambiguous values are a review point for client samples |
| `sys_di_key` records live in global scope | Field tuning runs in global scope | `gen_native_extraction.py` targets global and writes only changed values |

## 6. How to repeat

1. Attach the documents to intake records whose `source_reference` is `PH40-EVAL-<file name without .pdf>`.
2. Scripts - Background, scope global: `scripts/deploy/phase40_native_eval_run_bg.js` (one DocIntel task per document).
3. After about a minute: `scripts/deploy/phase40_native_eval_read_bg.js`; copy the `BCFA_EVAL` lines into a results JSON.
4. `python scripts/eval/score_extraction.py <results.json> <ground_truth.json> --md <score.md>`.

For client samples: write the ground truth from the document before running extraction, keep the documents and results outside git unless the client approves, and report them separately from these synthetic numbers.
